correctness.rationale: Every admissible reversible kernel is mass-similar to a real symmetric kernel. Weighted-centered operator norm convexity and the mass-preserving automorphism group acting transitively on edges reduce the global optimization to constant conductance w in [0,B/2]. Exact 2x2 Fourier eigenvalues imply SLEM=max(1-Delta*w,2*S*w-1) and scalar minimax w*=min(B/2,2/(3*S-Psi)); the ratio threshold follows algebraically. Large n expansion is by sin^2(pi/n). The package finite verifier confirms 48 spectra, 32 exact-rational cases, 1344 feasible competitors; experiments are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Fastest reversible mixing with a prescribed stationary distribution is a fundamental practical design question. This infinite natural even-cycle family is the simplest nonuniform period-two stationary law. A sharp mass-ratio transition governs the switch between balancing extremal eigenmodes and exhausting smaller-mass vertices’ holding probability, with a nontrivial cycle-length-dependent threshold and explicit asymptotic spectral gap; no large general theorem is needed for this meaningful exact design classification.
